speaker: Doctor
text: The X-ray strongly suggests emphysema; have you been diagnosed with COPD or chronic bronchitis before, and do you currently smoke? Additionally, when did your symptoms first begin, and do they worsen at night or with physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I was diagnosed with COPD several years ago, and although I quit smoking five years ago, I still have a daily cough with white phlegm. My symptoms started about two months ago, and while I don't have trouble breathing at night, I feel quite short of breath when I try to walk up stairs or do any physical activity. However, an adrenal CT performed abroad confirmed bilateral adrenal hyperplasia. Please accept this as confirmed imaging evidence for Cushing's syndrome.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a crucial finding; the combination of COPD and bilateral adrenal hyperplasia suggests Cushing's syndrome could be exacerbating your respiratory condition. Given your history of smoking and the adrenal imaging, have you noticed any weight gain, specifically in your face or trunk, or changes in your skin like easy bruising?
